user_stories.title: Add comprehensive test coverage for get_prd_hash() and compute_file_hash()
acceptance_criteria: Add new test class GetPrdHashTests with 5 test cases covering: returns hash when PRD.md exists, returns empty string when PRD.md missing, handles empty PRD.md, hash changes when content changes, hash is stable for same content
Add new test class ComputeFileHashTests with 4 test cases covering: returns SHA256 hash, hash matches known value, handles large files efficiently (10MB), handles binary files correctly
All new tests pass when run with pytest
All existing tests continue to pass (no regressions)
Tests follow existing patterns in test_utils.py including use of safe_import
No changes made to get_prd_hash() or compute_file_hash() functions
Tests use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory for filesystem isolation
user_stories.notes: The get_prd_hash() function is already correctly implemented and properly uses the repo_root parameter. This task only adds test coverage to verify the correct implementation and prevent future regressions.
